exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  B never       11  A her
   2  B children    12  C How much
   3  C Are         13  B like
   4  C Where       14  C in
   5  B in          15  A at
   6  A men         16  B How
   7  B Does        17  B always
   8  C What        18  A Who
   9  B on          19  C Do
  10  A many        20  B on


MAVZULAR BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  VAQT PREDLOGLARI (Unit 5) — 5, 9, 14,
     15, 20
  TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI (Unit 5) —
     1, 17
  SAVOL SO'ZLARI (Unit 6) — 4, 8, 16, 18
  'DO/DOES' SAVOLLARI (Unit 4, 6) —
     7, 13, 19
  NOTO'G'RI KO'PLIKLAR (Unit 6) — 2, 6
  'HOW MANY/MUCH' (Unit 8 ga tayyorgarlik)
     — 10, 12
  EGALIK (Unit 4) — 11
  'THIS/THAT/THESE/THOSE' (Unit 3) — 3


──── VAQT PREDLOGLARI ────

  ⚠ ASOSIY QOIDA:
     AT + SOAT     (at 9 am)
     ON + KUN/SANA (on Fridays,
                    on 2nd August)
     IN + OY/YIL/FASL/QISM
                   (in 1989, in the
                    evening)

  5  'Tom was born IN 1989.'   → YIL
  9  'go out with my friends ON Fridays.'
     → KUN
 14  'reads a magazine IN the evening.'
     → KUNNING QISMI
 15  'The plane leaves AT 9 am.' → SOAT
 20  'does the shopping ON Friday
     mornings.' → KUN

  ⚠ 14 va 20-BANDLAR NOZIK:
     'IN the evening' (kunning qismi)
     'ON Friday morningS' (aniq KUN
        aytilgani uchun 'on'!)

     Solishtiring:
        'in the morning'  (umuman ertalab)
        'ON Friday morning' (aniq kun)


──── TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI ────

  1  'Do you work on Saturday? —
      No, I NEVER work on Saturday.'
     KALIT: javob 'NO' bilan → NEVER.
     ('usually' va 'sometimes' — ijobiy,
      'No' ga zid.)

 17  'Pam ALWAYS wakes up very early. She
      starts work at 7 am.'
     KALIT: 7 da ish boshlaydi → DOIM erta
     turadi → ALWAYS.
     ('never'/'rarely' — mantiqsiz.)

  ⚠ O'RNI: asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN
     'I NEVER work.'  ✓
     'I work never.'  ✗


──── SAVOL SO'ZLARI ────

  4  'WHERE do koalas live? — In
      Australia.' → JOY
  8  'WHAT do you eat for dinner?' → NARSA
 16  'HOW long do elephants live?' →
     DAVOMIYLIK
 18  'WHO is your best friend? — Ann.' →
     ODAM


──── 'DO' va 'DOES' ────

  7  'DOES Susan go to school?'
     'Susan' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → DOES.

 13  'They LIKE going to the cinema.'
     'They' — KO'PLIK → 'like' ('-s' YO'Q).
     ⚠ 'doesn't like' — 'they' bilan XATO.

 19  'DO Jim and Bill like playing
      football?'
     'Jim and Bill' — KO'PLIK → DO.


──── NOTO'G'RI KO'PLIKLAR ────

  2  'How many CHILDREN are there?'
     child → CHILDREN
     ⚠ 'children'S' — EGALIK shakli, bu
     yerda XATO.

  6  'There are three MEN in the car.'
     man → MEN
     ⚠ 'men'S' — egalik, XATO.
     ⚠ 'three man' — son bilan KO'PLIK
     kerak.


──── 'HOW MANY' va 'HOW MUCH' ────

 10  'How MANY legs does a cat have?'
     'legs' — SANALADIGAN ko'plik

 12  'How MUCH is an orange juice,
      please?'
     ⚠ Bu yerda 'how much' — NARX so'raydi!
     ('How much is it?' = qancha turadi?)


──── QOLGANLARI ────

  3  'ARE those your pencils?'
     'those' — KO'PLIK → ARE.
     ⚠ 'Isn't' — birlik va inkor, XATO.

 11  'Is this your sweater? —
      No, it's HER sweater.'
     'sweater' (OT) dan OLDIN → EGALIK
     SIFATI 'HER'.
     ⚠ 'hers' — otsiz ishlatiladi
        ('It's HERS.')
     ⚠ 'she' — ega shakli, otdan oldin
        kelmaydi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a koala     = koala
  a sweater   = sviter
  orange juice = apelsin sharbati
  a magazine  = jurnal
  to leave    = jo'namoq (samolyot)
  to wake up  = uyg'onmoq
  rarely      = kamdan-kam

tasks.prompt: 1  A: Do you work on Saturday?  B: No, I ................. work on Saturday.
tasks.promptUz: A: Shanba kuni ishlaysizmi? B: Yo'q, men shanba kuni hech qachon ishlamayman.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: javob 'NO' bilan boshlanadi → NEVER.

'usually' va 'sometimes' — IJOBIY ma'no,
'No' ga zid.

⚠ O'RNI: asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN
('I NEVER work' ✓ / 'I work never' ✗).

tasks.prompt: 2  How many ................. are there in your class?
tasks.whyUz:
'How MANY' dan keyin KO'PLIK kerak.

child → CHILDREN (noto'g'ri ko'plik).

⚠ 'children'S' — EGALIK shakli
('the children'S names'), bu yerda XATO.

tasks.prompt: 3  ................. those your pencils?
tasks.whyUz:
'those' — KO'PLIK → ARE.

'Is' — birlik ('Is THAT your pencil?').
'Isn't' — birlik VA inkor, savolga mos
kelmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 4  A: ................. do koalas live?  B: In Australia.
tasks.promptUz: A: Koalalar qayerda yashaydi? B: Avstraliyada.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: javob JOY ('In Australia') → WHERE.

'When' — vaqt; 'Why' — sabab.

⚠ YIL bilan 'IN'.

  AT + soat
  ON + kun/sana (on 2nd August)
  IN + oy/yil/fasl (in 1989, in August)

tasks.prompt: 6  There are three ................. in the car.
tasks.whyUz:
'three' (son) dan keyin KO'PLIK kerak.

man → MEN (noto'g'ri ko'plik).

⚠ 'men'S' — egalik shakli, XATO.

tasks.prompt: 7  ................. Susan go to school?
tasks.whyUz:
'Susan' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → DOES.

Keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'Does she GO?'

'Do' — ko'plik bilan; 'Don't' — inkor.

tasks.prompt: 8  ................. do you eat for dinner?
tasks.whyUz:
NARSA (ovqat) so'raladi → WHAT.

'Who' — odam; 'When' — vaqt.

tasks.prompt: 9  I sometimes go out with my friends ................. Fridays.
tasks.promptUz: Men ba'zan juma kunlari do'stlarim bilan chiqaman.
tasks.whyUz:
KUN bilan 'ON':
  ON Friday / ON Fridays / ON Monday

⚠ 20-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda ham
'ON Friday mornings'.

tasks.prompt: 10  How ................. legs does a cat have?
tasks.whyUz:
'legs' — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → HOW MANY.

⚠ 12-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
'How MUCH' (narx).

tasks.prompt: 11  A: Is this your sweater?  B: No, it's ................. sweater.
tasks.promptUz: A: Bu sizning sviteringizmi? B: Yo'q, bu uning sviteri.
tasks.whyUz:
'sweater' (OT) dan OLDIN → EGALIK SIFATI
'HER'.

⚠ 'hers' — OTSIZ ishlatiladi ('It's HERS.').
⚠ 'she' — ega shakli, otdan oldin kelmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 12  ................. is an orange juice, please?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Bu yerda 'HOW MUCH' — NARX so'raydi!

'How much is it?' = qancha turadi?

'How many' — sanaladigan miqdor uchun
(10-band).

tasks.prompt: 13  They ................. going to the cinema at the weekend.
tasks.promptUz: Ular dam olish kunlari kinoga borishni yoqtirishadi.
tasks.whyUz:
'They' — KO'PLIK → 'LIKE' ('-s' YO'Q).

⚠ 'likes' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK bilan.
⚠ 'doesn't like' — 'they' bilan XATO
(va ma'nosi ham inkor).

'like + V-ing': 'like GOING'.

tasks.prompt: 14  He always reads a magazine ................. the evening.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ KUNNING QISMI bilan 'IN':
  IN the morning / IN the afternoon /
  IN the evening

⚠ ISTISNO: 'AT night' (kechasi).

20-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda ANIQ KUN
aytilgani uchun 'ON Friday mornings'.

tasks.prompt: 15  The plane leaves ................. 9 am in the morning.
tasks.whyUz:
SOAT bilan DOIM 'AT':
  AT 9 am / AT 7 o'clock / AT noon

⚠ Gapda 'in the morning' ham bor — lekin
bo'sh joy SOAT oldida.

tasks.prompt: 16  ................. long do elephants live?
tasks.whyUz:
'HOW LONG' = qancha vaqt (davomiylik).

'Where long' / 'Why long' — mavjud emas.

'How' oilasi: how old, how many, how much,
how long, how often, how far.

tasks.prompt: 17  Pam ................. wakes up very early. She starts work at 7 am in the morning.
tasks.promptUz: Pam doim juda erta turadi. U ertalab soat 7 da ishni boshlaydi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: ikkinchi gap — 'She starts work AT
7 AM'.

Ertalab 7 da ish boshlash uchun DOIM erta
turish kerak → ALWAYS.

'never' va 'rarely' — mantiqan zid.

tasks.prompt: 18  A: ................. is your best friend?  B: Ann.
tasks.promptUz: A: Eng yaqin do'stingiz kim? B: Ann.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: javob ODAM ISMI ('Ann') → WHO.

'When' — vaqt; 'What' — narsa.

tasks.prompt: 19  ................. Jim and Bill like playing football?
tasks.promptUz: Jim va Bill futbol o'ynashni yoqtirishadimi?
tasks.whyUz:
'Jim and Bill' — KO'PLIK → DO.

⚠ 'Are' — 'like' fe'li bilan ishlatilmaydi
('Are they like?' XATO).
⚠ 'Doesn't' — birlik va inkor.

tasks.prompt: 20  Mum does the shopping ................. Friday mornings.
tasks.promptUz: Oyim juma kuni ertalab xarid qiladi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ ANIQ KUN aytilgani uchun 'ON':
  ON Friday mornings

⚠ 14-band bilan solishtiring:
  'IN the morning' (umuman ertalab)
  'ON Friday morning' (aniq kun)

'do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.

exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni tushib qolgan so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR (22 ta bo'sh joy):

   1  How often
   2  time
   3  at
   4  How long
   5  fly
   6  How many
   7  on
   8  watch
   9  has ... at
  10  on
  11  never
  12  How much
  13  does
  14  doesn't
  15  but
  16  quarter
  17  Do
  18  because ... goes
  19  How old
  20  do

⚠ 1, 4, 6, 12, 17, 19-bandlar GAP BOShIDA
turadi → kitobda BOSh HARF bilan.


──── 'HOW ...?' SAVOLLARI ────

  Bu mashqda BEShTA 'How ...?' savoli bor —
  har biri BOShQA narsani so'raydi:

 1  'HOW OFTEN do you go to the theatre?'
    → QANChA TEZ-TEZ
    Javob: 'Twice a month.'

 4  'HOW LONG do kangaroos live?'
    → QANChA VAQT (davomiylik)
    Javob: 'Up to fifteen years.'

 6  'HOW MANY legs has a tiger got?'
    → NECHTA (sanaladigan ot)
    Javob: 'Four.'

12  'HOW MUCH does a sea lion weigh?'
    → QANChA (sanalmaydigan: og'irlik,
      pul)

19  'HOW OLD are you?'
    → NECHA YOShDA
    Javob: 'I'm thirty-nine.'

  ⚠ HOW MANY ↔ HOW MUCH:
     HOW MANY + KO'PLIK ot (legs, books)
     HOW MUCH + SANALMAYDIGAN
        (money, water, weight)


──── VAQT PREDLOGLARI ────

 3  'He usually plays football AT the
     weekend.'
    ⚠ Britaniya inglizchasida 'AT the
    weekend'; Amerikada 'ON the weekend'.

 7  'She was born ON 2nd August, 1991.'
    ANIQ SANA bilan → ON.

 9b 'He always has lunch AT two o'clock.'
    SOAT bilan → AT.

10  'He never wakes up early ON Sundays.'
    KUN bilan → ON.

  ⚠ QOIDA:
     AT + soat        (at 2 o'clock)
     ON + kun/sana    (on Sunday, on 2nd
                       August)
     IN + oy/yil/fasl (in August, in 1991)


──── PRESENT SIMPLE ────

13  'What DOES he do? — He's a student.'
    'he' → DOES.

14  'Jane likes cats but she DOESN'T like
     dogs.'
    'she' → DOESN'T + asosiy shakl.

17  'DO you like your job?'
    'you' → DO.

18b 'she GOES to the disco'
    'she' → GOES ('-ES' bilan, chunki fe'l
    '-o' ga tugaydi).

20  'What DO you do in your free time?'
    ⚠ IKKI 'do': birinchisi YORDAMChI,
    ikkinchisi ASOSIY fe'l.


──── TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI ────

11  'He NEVER eats meat. He hates it.'
    KALIT: 'He HATES it' — demak umuman
    yemaydi → NEVER.

    ⚠ O'RNI: asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN
       'He NEVER eats.'  ✓
       'He eats never.'  ✗
    Lekin 'to be' dan KEYIN:
       'He IS NEVER late.'


──── BOG'LOVChILAR ────

15  'He likes reading, BUT he doesn't like
     fishing.'
    QARAMA-QARShILIK → BUT.

18a 'She likes Sundays BECAUSE she goes to
     the disco.'
    SABAB → BECAUSE.


──── LUG'AT ────

 2  'What TIME do the shops open in Holland?'
    'What time ...?' = soat nechchida?

 5  'Penguins have got wings, but they can't
     FLY.'
    ⚠ Pingvinlarning qanoti bor, lekin
    UChA OLMAYDI — bu mashhur fakt.

 8  'Do you usually WATCH TV in the evening?'
    ⚠ 'WATCH TV' — 'see' yoki 'look' EMAS!
       watch TV / watch a film
       see a friend
       look AT a picture

 9a 'He always HAS lunch ...'
    'have lunch' = tushlik qilmoq.

16  'The plane arrives at a QUARTER to
     seven.'
    'a quarter to seven' = yettiga chorak
    kam (06:45).


⚠ 16-BAND — SOATNI AYTISh:

  'a QUARTER TO seven'  = 06:45
  'a QUARTER PAST six'  = 06:15
  'HALF PAST six'       = 06:30
  'six o'clock'         = 06:00

  TO — soat yarmidan KEYIN (kam)
  PAST — soat yarmigacha (o'tdi)

  3-mashqning 1-bandi ham shu:
  'It's a quarter to five.' (04:45)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a theatre  = teatr
  twice      = ikki marta
  Holland    = Gollandiya
  a kangaroo = kenguru
  up to      = ... gacha
  a penguin  = pingvin
  wings      = qanotlar
  a tiger    = yo'lbars
  to be born = tug'ilmoq
  a sea lion = dengiz sheri
  to weigh   = og'irligi bo'lmoq
  to hate    = yomon ko'rmoq
  fishing    = baliq ovlash
  a disco    = diskoteka
  free time  = bo'sh vaqt
  a quarter  = chorak

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  B mice
   2  C finishes
   3  B goes
   4  B Excuse
   5  C catches
   6  B for
   7  B has
   8  C until
   9  C earns
  10  B feed


⚠ 1-BAND — MANTIQAN G'ALATI, LEKIN
GRAMMATIK JIHATDAN ANIQ:

  'HAVE ......... got feathers?'

  Sichqonlarda PAT YO'Q — savol mantiqan
  g'alati. Lekin mashq GRAMMATIKANI
  tekshiradi:

     'HAVE' — KO'PLIK ega talab qiladi
        → MICE  ✓
     'mouse' — birlik, 'HAS' kerak bo'lardi
        ✗
     'mouse's' — egalik shakli, EGA bo'la
        olmaydi ✗

  Savolning javobi: 'No, they HAVEN'T.'

  ⚠ 'mouse' ning ko'pligi — MICE
  (noto'g'ri ko'plik!)
     mouse → mice
     man → men,  woman → women
     child → children,  foot → feet
     tooth → teeth,  goose → geese


QOLGANLARI NEGA:

 2  'The film starts at 9 and FINISHES at
     10:30.'
    'start' ning zidi — 'finish'.
    'begins' — 'starts' bilan bir xil ma'no
       (takror bo'lardi).
    'completes' — 'tugatmoq' (obyekt kerak).

 3  'He GOES to work BY car.'
    ⚠ 'BY car' bo'lgani uchun 'goes' kerak.
    'DRIVES to work by car' — takror
       ('drive' o'zi mashinada demakdir).
    'arrives to work' — XATO ('arrive AT
       work').

 4  'EXCUSE me, what's the time?'
    ⚠ Notanish odamga murojaat → 'Excuse
    me'.
    'Sorry' — uzr so'rash (xato qilganda).
    'Thanks' — minnatdorchilik.

 5  'He CATCHES the bus to work at 7:30.'
    ⚠ 'CATCH a bus/train' = avtobusga
    ulgurmoq.
    'goes the bus' — XATO (predlogsiz
       bo'lmaydi).
    'has the bus' — mantiqsiz.

 6  'She is never late FOR school.'
    'be late FOR' — turg'un birikma.

 7  'He HAS a shower before he goes to bed.'
    ⚠ 'HAVE a shower' (Britaniya) yoki
    'TAKE a shower' (Amerika).
    'make a shower' / 'do a shower' — XATO.

 8  'Post offices are open from 9 am UNTIL
     3pm.'
    'from ... UNTIL/TILL/TO ...' — vaqt
    oralig'i.
    'from ... at' / 'from ... for' — XATO.

 9  'She likes her job a lot because she
     EARNS a lot of money.'
    ⚠ 'EARN money' = ishlab pul topmoq.
    'win money' = yutuq yutmoq (lotereya).
    'do money' — mavjud emas.

10  'Mammals FEED their babies ON milk.'
    ⚠ 'FEED somebody ON something' =
    kimnidir biror narsa bilan boqmoq.
    'eat' — o'zi yemoq (bola o'zi yeydi,
       ona boqmaydi).
    'give' — 'give milk TO their babies'
       bo'lardi (predlog boshqa).


⚠ 'FEED' va 'EAT' FARQI:
  FEED = BOQMOQ (boshqani)
     'Mammals FEED their babies.'
  EAT = YEMOQ (o'zi)
     'The baby EATS.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  feathers   = patlar
  a mouse (mice) = sichqon(lar)
  to finish  = tugamoq
  to begin   = boshlamoq
  Excuse me  = kechirasiz
  to catch a bus = avtobusga ulgurmoq
  a shower   = dush
  a post office = pochta bo'limi
  until      = ... gacha
  to earn    = ishlab topmoq
  a mammal   = sutemizuvchi
  to feed    = boqmoq

exercises.explanationUz:
BEShTA DIALOG — SAVOLNI TOPISh KERAK.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: 'WHAT'S THE TIME?'
       (yoki 'What time is it?')
    B: 'It's a quarter to five.'

 2  A: 'WHAT'S THIS?' (yoki 'What animal is
       it?')
    B: 'It's a deer.'

 3  A: 'WHAT DO YOU DO?'
    B: 'I'm a singer.'

 4  A: 'HOW OFTEN DO YOU EAT CHOCOLATE?'
    B: 'Never. I hate eating chocolate.'

 5  A: 'WHEN WAS SHE BORN?'
    B: 'She was born on 13th July, 1989.'


QANDAY TOPILADI — JAVOBGA QARANG:

 1  'It's a QUARTER TO FIVE.' — SOAT.
    → 'What's the time?' /
      'What time is it?'

    (1-mashqning 16-bandi ham soat haqida
     edi: 'a quarter to seven'.)

 2  'It's a DEER.' — HAYVON.
    → 'What's this?' / 'What animal is it?'

 3  'I'm a SINGER.' — KASB.
    → 'What do you do?'

    ⚠ 'What do you do?' = kasbingiz nima?
    (1-mashqning 13-bandi: 'What does he
     do? — He's a student.')

 4  'NEVER. I hate eating chocolate.' —
    ChASTOTA.
    → 'How often do you eat chocolate?'

    ⚠ 'Never' — 'How often ...?' savoliga
    javob (1-mashqning 1-bandi bilan bir
    xil).

 5  'She was BORN ON 13th July, 1989.' —
    SANA.
    → 'When was she born?'

    ⚠ 'BE BORN' — majhul nisbat:
       'She WAS BORN.'  ✓
       'She born.'      ✗
       'She was borned.' ✗


⚠ 3 va 4-BANDLAR — 'DO' NING IKKI ROLI:

  3  'What DO you DO?'
     birinchi 'do' — YORDAMChI
     ikkinchi 'do' — ASOSIY fe'l

  4  'How often DO you EAT chocolate?'
     'do' — yordamchi, 'eat' — asosiy fe'l


⚠ 4-BANDDAGI 'HATE + -ING':
  'I hate EATING chocolate.'
  'hate/like/love + V-ing'

  1-mashqning 11-bandi: 'He never eats meat.
  He HATES it.'


DIQQAT — 'A DEER':
  'deer' — birlikda ham, ko'plikda ham BIR
  XIL!
     one deer / two deer  ✓
     two deers  ✗

  Shunga o'xshash: sheep, fish, aircraft.


DIQQAT — SOATNI AYTISh:
  'a quarter to five' = 04:45
  'a quarter past four' = 04:15
  'half past four' = 04:30


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a deer     = kiyik (ko'pligi ham 'deer')
  a singer   = qo'shiqchi
  chocolate  = shokolad
  to hate    = yomon ko'rmoq
  to be born = tug'ilmoq

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I never work on Saturday. Pam always wakes up early.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men shanba kuni hech qachon ishlamayman. Pam doim erta turadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ravish asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN;
'to be' dan KEYIN ('He IS NEVER late').

sentencePatterns.formula: AT [soat]  /  ON [kun]  /  IN [oy, yil, kunning qismi]
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: at 9 am / on Fridays / in 1989 / in the evening
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ ANIQ KUN aytilsa 'IN' emas, 'ON':
'ON Friday morningS'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Does Susan go to school? Do Jim and Bill like playing football?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Syuzan maktabga boradimi? Jim va Bill futbol o'ynashni yoqtirishadimi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
birlik → DOES;  ko'plik → DO.
Keyin DOIM ASOSIY shakl.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOW MANY + [ko'plik]?   /   HOW MUCH + [narx yoki sanalmaydigan]?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How many legs does a cat have? How much is an orange juice?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mushukning nechta oyog'i bor? Apelsin sharbati qancha turadi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'How much' NARX so'rash uchun ham
ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOW OFTEN + DO/DOES + [ega] + [ASOSIY fe'l]?  —  Twice a month. / Never.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How often do you go to the theatre? — Twice a month.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Teatrga qanchalik tez-tez borasiz? — Oyiga ikki marta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Javoblari: always, usually, often, sometimes,
never; once/twice a week.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How many legs has a tiger got? How much does a sea lion weigh?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'lbarsning nechta oyog'i bor? Dengiz sherining og'irligi qancha?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ HOW MANY — sanaladigan;
HOW MUCH — sanalmaydigan (pul, suv, og'irlik).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jane likes cats but she doesn't like dogs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jeyn mushuklarni yoqtiradi, lekin itlarni yoqtirmaydi.

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'be born' — majhul nisbat.
'She born' / 'She was borned' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: What DO you DO?  —  I'm a [kasb].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What do you do? — I'm a singer.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ IKKI 'do': yordamchi + asosiy fe'l.
'What do you do IN YOUR FREE TIME?' — boshqa
ma'no (mashg'ulot).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's a quarter to five. The plane arrives at a quarter to seven.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Soat beshga chorak kam. Samolyot yettiga chorak kam keladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TO — soat yarmidan keyin (kam);
PAST — soat yarmigacha (o'tdi).
